verdict.rationale: Ardent's docs describe a headless-friendly CLI and API. ARDENT_TOKEN auth needs no login step, `--print-url` and `--format json` give machine-readable output, errors are JSON with stable codes, and re-runs are idempotent. There is also a dedicated CI/CD workflow in which every PR gets its own branch, driven by a script or CI harness. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage (all evidence is vendor docs), and no published OpenAPI spec for the automation API.
